chunks: 2- And from him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥammād ibn Zayd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yaḥyā al-Kāhilī, from his father, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Shayṭān continues to be fearful and terrified of the affair of the believer, in awe of him, so long as he maintains the five salat (prayers). But when he neglects them, he becomes bold against him.”

key_terms.اجْتَرَأَ: he became bold and daring against him
key_terms.الشَّيْطَانُ: Shayṭān, the satanic enemy who seeks influence over the believer
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer, whose faith and practice grant spiritual strength
key_terms.ضَيَّعَهُنَّ: he neglected them or allowed them to be lost
key_terms.مَا حَافَظَ: so long as he carefully maintains and preserves

ai.seo_question: How do the five daily salat (prayers) protect a believer from Shayṭān?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that guarding the five daily salat (prayers) gives the believer spiritual protection and keeps Shayṭān at bay. Neglecting them removes that protection and allows Shayṭān to become emboldened against the person.
